message.text:
The s3presign runner is the component that prevents external attachment links from going stale. I will now format the answer as requested.

The schedule is every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup via `startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go`, called from `Start` at line 129. The runner itself is instantiated at line 162.

h01.
s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

The `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` re-presigns S3 attachment URLs (`CheckAndPresign`) on a `time.Hour * 12` ticker so stored external links do not expire. `Server.Start` starts it via `startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:129`), which constructs the runner, runs it once immediately, then launches `Run` as a background goroutine.
